_: Text of the README 'How it works' figure (v2/where-chock-sits.png), read by render.mjs. Component names are generic: no vendor is named. 'points' is every place Chock meets the agent or the repository, in session order; tests/test_readme_picture.py derives the same list from the engine (Surface enum, git script events, the agentseam events chock uses) and fails when they differ. 'proof' lists the tests that prove each point (checked, not drawn). Not drawn, because the engine does not wire them: a prompt-submit hook; the managed-setting and gateway surfaces. Stops: policies with status production in chock-catalog registry.yaml (rel12-catalog) that stay production after CAT-S1; 'in-agent' marks a best-effort tool-call guard (registry enforcement: advise), 'commit' a gate that blocks.
title: You keep working with your agent as before. Chock checks each action before it lands.

context.name: Context
context.line: rules files such as AGENTS.md, skills, memory

hook.name: Hook point
hook.line: the harness asks before a tool runs

tools.name: Tools
tools.line: edit file, write file, run command, git

chock.name: Chock
chock.line: a local program; its rules are files in your repository; no model, no tokens

stops.line: a password or API key written into code
a container that runs as root or uses a floating image tag such as latest
a download piped straight into a shell
data sent to a host you have not approved
the agent weakening the checks that review its work (asks you first)

footer: The rules are files in your repository. A person turns them on once with chock sync.
alt: A layered sketch: you ask a coding agent for a change. Inside the agent, a model and an agent loop work with context, and tool calls pass a hook point before the tools run. Chock sits below and meets the agent at nine points: session start, a rules block in context, before and after each tool, the end of the turn and an MCP gateway, then your repository at git commit, git push and CI.

points.name: Session start
points.line: arms the hooks from what is committed.

points.name: Rules in context
points.line: a short rules block Chock writes into AGENTS.md. Advisory.

points.name: Before a tool runs
points.line: Chock judges the call: allow, ask or block. A refusal goes back to the model with one line on what to do instead.

points.name: After a tool runs
points.line: records what ran, for checks that read the session. It never changes a verdict.

points.name: End of the turn
points.line: reads what the turn left in the working tree and refuses to end the turn on a finding. A backstop.

points.name: MCP gateway
points.line: a proxy that judges calls to an MCP server.
points.scope: where a server is set up through it

points.name: In CI
points.line: the same gates on the pull request.
